text: Signals-file Source URL must be written exactly as the draft anchors cite them (https, no arXiv version suffix). Draft said https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26361 while the signals row said http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26361v1 and finish failed 'anchor not traceable'. Write canonical https form in the radar file.

The illustration director often quotes the frontmatter meta_description as its cue, which the verbatim-cue check refuses (3 deterministic retries). Re-run with DIRECTOR_MAX_ATTEMPTS=6 before hand-editing anything.

wp_draft --refresh-live updates a PUBLISHED post without a status transition, so the mu-plugin does not fire and the static fronts keep the old build. After any refresh/reimage on a live post, run giniloh_coolify_redeploy_all() from the giniloh CMS container, then poll the live page.

The Hermes venv python has no pip/pytest, so verify.sh's pytest suites fail on ModuleNotFoundError. Fix: python3 -m ensurepip then python3 -m pip install pytest; run the 'from scripts.x import' test files with PYTHONPATH=/root/editorial-factory.

article_reviewer held two fresh rewrites in one run on its OWN output, not the standing final: attempt 1 emptied the nuanced-takeaway section, attempt 2 dropped the tension first-person cue — alternating single hard failures. The standing _final.md passed review_audit --draft --final (PASS) while the reviewer loop could not reproduce a clean rewrite. Recovery: read the held file to see whose text failed, then rely on review_audit + the gate battery on the standing final rather than burning a third frontier rewrite.
